description: This file defines an interface for building responses to live 'RetrieveThing' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes nested interface 'ResponseFactory' responsible for creating success and error responses related to 'RetrieveThing' operations.

classes.name: RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command responses for 'RetrieveThing' commands, extending a query command response step.

classes.name: RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Nested interface serving as a factory for creating success and error responses related to 'RetrieveThing' operations.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing the retrieved Thing object.

methods.name: thingNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating that the Thing does not exist or the request is not authorized.
